title: Anagram mappings
statementMd:
`b` is an anagram of list `a` (same multiset). Return a list `m` where `m[i]` is an index `j` in `b` with `b[j] == a[i]`, using each index of `b` once and always the smallest unused one.

**Example:** `anagram_mapping([12, 28, 46, 32, 50], [50, 12, 32, 46, 28])` returns `[1, 4, 3, 2, 0]`.
hints: Map each value to a queue of indices.
